# Delteris / Elenchon

> Engineering the technology for Europe's future.

Elenchon is on-premise welding traceability software for fabrication shops and heavy industry. It runs the full WPS/PQR/WPQ qualification workflow, automates ISO and ASME IX compliance ledgers, captures shop-floor data in seconds, and keeps every weld record on the client's own hardware via Phrakton — Delteris's zero-trust network overlay built on OpenZiti and secured with post-quantum cryptography.

## Core Pillars
- Zero-Friction Work Capture (10-second navigation, universal work templates)
- One Project, Two Live Views (Tree & Flowchart, one-paste BOM import from Tekla/CAD)
- Management & Access Control (global custom roles, one-click document generation)
- Qualifications & Procedures (WPS/PQR/WPQ workflow, 6-month continuity tracking, heat propagation)
- Floor Asset & Consumable Control (maintenance hub, machine certification tracking, batch inventory)
- Bulletproof Data Sovereignty (on-premise appliance, automated local backups, post-quantum-safe encryption)

## Pricing (EUR, per appliance, per month, excl. VAT)
- Lite: €400/month, 20 workers included. The full traceability core — work capture, project tree and flowchart, BOM import, WPS/PQR/WPQ workflow, ISO & ASME IX ledgers, preset roles, Phrakton networking, local backups, founder support by email. Expandable by up to two 10-worker blocks, to a 40-worker ceiling.
- Standard: €880/month, 50 workers included. Everything in Lite plus the full platform (all six pillars), floor asset and consumable control, global custom roles, a pre-deployment on-site scoping session, on-site training run as two 3-hour blocks, unlimited worker expansion blocks, and direct founder support.
- Premium: coming soon.
- Add-ons: Remote Access Module €200/month (incl. 100 GB); 10 Additional Workers €90/month per block of 10, each block including 20 GB of recurring remote bandwidth free; Remote Bandwidth €25 per 100 GB.
- Plan changes: upgrades, downgrades and add-ons are applied remotely over the Phrakton fabric at no charge. Give at least 15 days' notice. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades at the next billing cycle.
- One-time: Lite Deployment & Training package €1,100 (installation plus one training session of two 2-hour blocks, no pre-deployment scoping visit); Standard Deployment & Training €1,700 all in (€850 deployment + €850 floor training, training run as two 3-hour blocks); Server Appliance ~€300–400 at cost; On-Site Commute Fee €150/visit.
- Professional services: Extra Training Session €500 (half day of two 2-hour blocks, or full day of two 3-hour blocks); Network Consulting €500 half day / €850 full day; PQS (post-quantum security) Consulting €500 half day / €850 full day.
- Uptime: 99.9% monthly commitment on the Phrakton fabric, with automatic invoice credits when missed — 10% for 99.0–99.8%, 25% for 97.0–99.0%, 50% for 90.0–97.0%, and 100% (the month is free) below 89.9%.
- No per-audit fees, no lock-in — customers who cancel keep permanent view-only access to historical data for audits.

## Deployment
Three steps: scoping session with the founders, on-site installation of the hardware appliance, then onboarding and go-live. Deployment slots per quarter are limited because every appliance is installed on-site by Delteris engineers. Lite deployments skip the pre-deployment scoping visit and include a single training session of two 2-hour blocks; Standard training runs as two 3-hour blocks.
